pages.text: Each fuel multiplies the engine's speed, efficiency and torque (speed / efficiency / torque): $(li)$(item)Gasoline$(): 1 / 1 / 1 - $(item)Diesel$(): 0.8 / 0.8 / 1.4 - $(item)Kerosene$(): 0.7 / 1 / 1.4 - $(item)Naphtha$(): 1 / 0.7 / 1.3 - $(item)LPG$():

Diesel and kerosene are the heavy-duty fuels, the gases spin fast but weak, and creosote and furnace gas are cheap by-products for a first engine. These values multiply those of the engine type and of the upgrades. Modpacks can change them with datapacks.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
